content.short: Chiliz is the blockchain powering Socios.com, a leading sports NFT marketplace.
content.description: Chiliz is a leading player in the sport NFT world and serves as the underlying blockchain behind Socios.com, a global platform for sports NFTs. Through this ecosystem, fans can connect with their favorite athletes and clubs in new ways, participating in fan-driven activities and ownership experiences that are unique to the blockchain space. Chiliz has established partnerships with Barcelona, Liverpool, and several other prominent football clubs, reflecting its significant footprint in the world of sports digital assets.
